description: Schema for shape moved event. This is a duration event that tracks shape position changes, batching rapid movements into a single event that ends after 1500ms of inactivity.

shapeId.description: The unique identifier of the shape that was moved

xStart.description: The x-coordinate position of the shape at the start of the move

yStart.description: The y-coordinate position of the shape at the start of the move

xEnd.description: The x-coordinate position of the shape at the end of the move

yEnd.description: The y-coordinate position of the shape at the end of the move

reason.description: Optional reason for ending the move event (e.g., 'deleted', 'cleanup')
